name: Witch Doctor Cauldron utility spellmods work natively (#1255, #2300, #1379)
contract: #1255 Plentiful Potions 803463 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), EffectBasePoints -11 (-10% at DieSides 1), EffectSpellClassMask word1 8519680 = Loa's Brew 801670 (SpellFamilyFlags word1 131072) | Hexbreak 806240 (SpellFamilyFlags word1 8388608). SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies SPELLMOD_COST generically, so both named spells cost about 90% of baseline once learned, no module code needed. #2300 Brewmaster 704512/707856 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), EffectSpellClassMask word1 131072 matching Loa's Brew only; rank 1 EffectBasePoints -251 resolves to -250 ms, rank 2 -501 resolves to -500 ms. Unit::CalcCastTime calls ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME) generically (Unit.cpp, Player::ApplySpellMod at Player.cpp:10219). #1379 Blessing of Hir'eek 572870 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), EffectBasePoints 0 / DieSides 1 (+1), EffectSpellClassMask word1 8388608 matching Hexbreak only. Hexbreak's own effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL with EffectBasePoints 0 / DieSides 1 (dispel count 1, matching its tooltip '$s1 curse effect'); SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp) runs every effect, including SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL, through Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers -> ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), so the resolved effect value read by spell_effect_value is exactly what Spell::EffectDispel uses as dispelCount (SpellEffects.cpp:2925, dispelCount = damage). Player::ApplySpellMod's per-mod dispel-chance gate does not apply here; Aura::CalcDispelChance (SpellAuras.cpp:1142) defaults resistChance to 0 for a friendly (non-offensive) dispel, so a same-run Hexbreak cast against curses on an ally is a deterministic 100% dispel; with two distinct curses present and Blessing's dispel count raised to 2, Spell::EffectDispel's loop (SpellEffects.cpp:2947) consumes the whole 2-entry dispel list regardless of its random per-entry selection order, so both are removed deterministically. All three mechanisms are stock engine paths under src/server/game/Spells and src/server/game/Entities/Player, not src/server/coa; no fix is proposed. Curse of Weakness 702 (SpellFamilyName 5/Warlock, Dispel 2/DISPEL_CURSE) and Curse of Stalvan 3105 (SpellFamilyName 0/generic, Dispel 2/DISPEL_CURSE) are used as the two simultaneous curses: SpellInfo::GetSpellSpecific (SpellInfo.cpp) only assigns SPELL_SPECIFIC_CURSE to SPELLFAMILY_WARLOCK spells with Dispel==DISPEL_CURSE, and Aura::CanStackWith's same-caster SPELL_SPECIFIC_CURSE exclusivity (SpellAuras.cpp:1996, SpellInfo::IsAuraExclusiveBySpecificPerCasterWith) removes a second self-applied Warlock curse from the same caster (e.g. 702+980, both Warlock-family) before it can land; a generic (family 0) DISPEL_CURSE debuff such as 3105 is unaffected by that exclusivity while still matching Hexbreak's dispel mask, which only checks each aura's own Dispel field (Spell::EffectDispel -> GetDispellableAuraList, SpellEffects.cpp:2930), not its SpellFamilyName.
